description: This file defines the SelectedGroupField class, which represents an entity in the OrangeHRM system related to selected group fields within reports. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to a database table and specifies relationships to other entities such as GroupField, SummaryDisplayField, and Report.

classes.name: SelectedGroupField
classes.description: Entity class representing a selected group field in a report, with associations to GroupField, SummaryDisplayField, and Report entities.
